description: This file defines the FavoritesController class, which manages HTTP endpoints for favoriting and unfavoriting articles in a web application. It uses dependency injection for IMediator and includes authorization attributes for protected routes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller handling favorite and unfavorite article operations.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an article to favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article from favorites.
